title: Max Width
description: A fifteen-second promo for Abbey Road cut in the style of a Pinterest launch film: a giant grotesk Big, the cover on a white card that stretches to max. width, a search bar typing abbey roa, a grid of Beatles covers and a red end slate. Scrub the keyframed timeline to any frame, or let it loop over herb's beat.
intent: One editorial motion-graphics film where every element is a pure function of the playhead, so the timeline can be scrubbed frame-exact and every cut lands on the beat with the same tight easing.
